title: A token-bucket rate limiter with an explicit clock

api.name: TokenBucket
api.signature: export class TokenBucket { constructor(capacity: number, refillPerSecond: number, startTimeMs?: number); tryTake(count: number, nowMs: number): boolean; available(nowMs: number): number }

constraints: Never read the real clock. Time only ever arrives through the `nowMs` arguments.
The module must be plain ES module JavaScript.
